newsitem.title: USA: Group questions record date for Rexene meet.
newsitem.headline: Group questions record date for Rexene meet.

text.p: The Wyser-Pratte/Spear, Leeds & Kellogg group said on Tuesday it questioned the decision of Rexene Corp setting April 18 as the record date for a special shareholders' meeting on April 30.

In an amended complaint filed with the Delaware Chancery Court, the group said the Rexene board breached its fiduciary duty by setting a late record date for the meeting and asked that the date be set no later than April 1.

The group, which is seeking to remove the current board of Rexene, said that by setting an interval of only 12 calendar days and eight business days before the meeting, Rexene aimed "to prevent as many shareholders as possible from voting at the meeting."

The group had filed the original complaint on February 14. That complaint sought to compel the Rexene board to set a record date for the special meeting. Rexene announced the record date, as well as the date of the special meeting, on February 28. The group holds a 10.1 percent stake in Rexene, a maker of thermoplastics and petrochemicals.
It wants Rexene to consider a previously rejected $16-a-share acquisition offer from Huntsman Corp, or other higher offers.
For that purpose, it wants to gain control of the Rexene board. It said it would seek proxies for four candidates to the Rexene board for election at the special meeting.
It has also notified Rexene of its plan to nominate six candidates to the board at a still unscheduled annual meeting of the company this year. Rexene has a 10-member board.
